description: This file provides a helper client for interacting with Supabase's PostgREST API within a FastAPI backend. It includes functions for constructing headers with user JWTs and service roles, and a class for making REST requests (select, insert, update) with proper error handling.

classes.name: SupabaseRestClient
classes.description: A minimal client for interacting with Supabase's PostgREST API, supporting select, insert, and update operations with RLS-aware headers.

methods.name: _require_env
methods.description: Fetches a required environment variable or raises an error if not set.

methods.name: _require_anon_key
methods.description: Returns the Supabase anonymous key, accepting either the new or legacy environment variable.

methods.name: _supabase_url
methods.description: Retrieves the Supabase URL from environment variables.

methods.name: postgrest_headers_from_user
methods.description: Builds headers for user JWT-based RLS-aware requests to PostgREST.

methods.name: postgrest_headers_service_role
methods.description: Builds headers for service role requests to PostgREST, bypassing RLS.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SupabaseRestClient with the provided Supabase URL.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with error handling and response parsing.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Performs a SELECT query on a specified table with optional filters, ordering, and limit.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts rows into a specified table with optional return format.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates rows in a specified table based on filters with a patch object.
